LinkingLion: An entity linking Bitcoin transactions to IPs? Observations
In March 2023, I published https://b10c.me/observations/06-linkinglion/ about an entity which opens connections to many Bitcoin nodes using four IP address ranges and listens to transaction announcements. This might allow the entity to link newly broadcast transactions to node IP addresses. The entity has been active in some capacity since 2018 and is also active on the Monero network using the same IP address ranges.
